plainLanguage: Amarillo is colder than the rest of Texas (climate zone 4B), so walls, attic and windows need more insulation than in Dallas or Houston. Frost goes deeper here; plan footings around 24 inches deep until the city confirms its frost line. Snow loads and hail are real design issues; impact-resistant roofing is strongly recommended. We could not confirm the city's adopted code edition, zoning setbacks or fees, so those must be checked with the city.
openQuestions: Adopted IRC edition and local Table R301.2(1) (snow load, frost depth ~18-24 in, wind).
Whether Potter vs Randall County side changes anything (both CZ 4B).
